commits.subject: core: TDebugFile.Create() won't delete an unreadable .mab file
commits.body:
The .mab is a cache next to the executable, but its file name can also be
supplied as aExeName, e.g. by the LogView tool - in which case deleting the
user file on any loading problem is unexpected.
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: core: fixed TSynLogFile/TSynLogFileView edge cases found by the LogView tool
commits.body:
- TSynLogFileView.GetLineForClipboard() did index fLevels = nil on a plain
  text file: return the raw line, as LineContains() does since #591
- TSynLogFile.SetLogProcMerged(true) did dereference fLogProcNatural[0] and
  fLogProcMerged[0] when the log has no sllEnter at all
- TSynLogFileView.Select() did reset fSelectedCount only if some level was
  selected, so unchecking all levels did keep the previous rows selected -
  and it did index fLevels = nil on a plain text file
- new regression tests in TTestCoreBase.Debugging
commits.author: Sven Harazim
